subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Probabilistic Forecasting
description: A short lesson to help you apply Probabilistic Forecasting.

hook.text: The forecast says 1,000 units. But is that the most likely outcome or just the average of many scenarios?

buildup.text: Probabilistic forecasting provides a range of outcomes with their likelihoods, not just a single number.

discovery.text: Instead of 'demand will be 1,000,' it says 'there's a 70% chance demand is between 800 and 1,200.'

twist.text: Single-point forecasts give false confidence. A range forces planners to think about uncertainty explicitly.

climax.text: Probabilistic models let companies set inventory levels based on desired service level probabilities.

punchline.text: Don't forecast a number. Forecast a range of possibilities.

quiz.question: What does probabilistic forecasting provide?
options: A range of outcomes with their likelihoods
